newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia names reformers as representatives to UES.
newsitem.headline: Russia names reformers as representatives to UES.

text.p: The Russian government has named special representatives to national electricity company UES, in which it holds a 52 percent stake, Interfax news agency said on Tuesday.

It quoted a government order as saying Minister Yevgeny Yasin, who is a primary coordinator of Russian economic reform plans, First Deputy Finance Minister Alexei Kudrin and representatives of the economy ministry, state anti-monopoly committee, state property committee and federal energy committee had been appointed.

First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov earlier said the government might increase its control over UES, which is a target for reform due to high prices and major debts to the government and pension funds.
Nemtsov has criticised company management especially for payment problems.
